gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with histologically confirmed diagnosis of surgically accessible recurrent/progressive glioblastoma will be enrolled in this study

candidate_evidence.quote: GROUP B: Beginning 14 days prior to scheduled surgery, patients receive placebo IV.
I. To evaluate the influence of pembrolizumab on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of progressive/recurrent glioblastoma.

combination_partners: autologous tumor lysate-pulsed dendritic cell vaccine (ATL-DC)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: I. To evaluate the influence of pembrolizumab on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of progressive/recurrent glioblastoma.

The differences of PD-1, PD-L1, CD3, CD4, CD8, Iba-I, Ki-67 protein expression level between the archival tumor (collected pre-treatment) and protocol tumor (collected post-neoadjuvant treatment) will be assessed using paired T-test

coder_notes: Randomised pembrolizumab vs placebo, both arms receive ATL-DC vaccine + poly ICLC. Pembrolizumab is the only investigational pharmacological agent (experimental_monotherapy); DC vaccine is an excluded type; poly ICLC given in every arm as vaccine adjuvant coded soc_backbone (could alternatively be seen as part of the vaccine regimen/supportive; not a candidate either way). Placebo (registered as Other) not listed as an agent. Group B registered as ACTIVE_COMPARATOR. Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab with pre/post tumour sampling for PD markers -> target_engagement yes. No plasma or tumour PK described.
